title: GitHubAPIPlugin
description: Link in-game players to GitHub profiles and expose profile data through PlaceholderAPI placeholders.
body:
# GitHubAPIPlugin

**Link your GitHub account and show player stats via PlaceholdersAPI**

## Description
This plugin allows players to link their GitHub account to the server. Administrators can display GitHub profile information (followers, bio, repositories, etc.) using [PlaceholdersAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi).

**MySQL DATABASE IS REQUIRED !!!**

## Features
- Link GitHub account with `/githubapi link <username>`
- Show linked account with `/githubapi show`
- Over 20 placeholders: `%githubapi_login%`, `%githubapi_followers%`, `%githubapi_public_repos%` and more
- Async MySQL storage (pool of 5 threads)
- GitHub token support (up to 5000 requests/hour)
- Fully customizable messages in `config.yml`

## Requirements
- Java 8+
- Spigot/Paper 1.12 – latest
- [PlaceholdersAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi) 2.12.2+
- MySQL database

## Commands & Permissions

| Command | Permission | Default |
|---------|------------|---------|
| `/githubapi link <username>` | `githubapi.command.link` | OP |
| `/githubapi show` | `githubapi.command.show` | true |

Base permission: `githubapi.command`

## Placeholders (examples)
- `%githubapi_login%`
- `%githubapi_name%`
- `%githubapi_bio%`
- `%githubapi_followers%`
- `%githubapi_public_repos%`

Full list in the [README](https://github.com/Kredwi/GitHubAPIPlugin#readme).

## GitHub API Limits
- Without token: 60 requests/hour (per server IP)
- With personal access token: 5000 requests/hour

## Installation
1. Download the JAR from [Releases](https://github.com/Kredwi/GitHubAPIPlugin/releases)
2. Place in `/plugins` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Configure `config.yml` (database, token, messages)
5. Grant permissions to players
